result: No actionable introduced correctness defects found.

coverage.checked: Transposed affine 4-bit/group-64 word indexing, low-nibble-first extraction, one scale/bias per 64 values, staged activation addressing, exact eight-value word tails.
f32, f16, and bf16 storage/load/store paths; dtype equality and capability gates; matching shader selection for tree and subgroup variants.

Fixed staged_x[4864] allocation plus 256-float reduction scratch is included in the device byte-limit check. Dispatch requires matrix_k <= 4864. Shape validation at primitives.cpp:6458-6465 makes Q4/group-64 K divisible by 64, so the shader's k+7 reads are bounded.
Per-batch x/weight/scale/bias offsets, N not divisible by eight via column_active, inactive tree slots contributing zero, and no partial packed-word K tail under the validated shape contract.

Subgroup dispatch requires subgroup size 32 and arithmetic support; subgroupAdd is subgroup-uniform because each 32-lane slot shares column_active. Tree barriers remain workgroup-uniform. The pre-staging barrier between batches prevents the subgroup path from overwriting staged_x while another subgroup still reads the prior batch.
All six Q4-word binaries (f32/f16/bf16 × tree/subgroup) are compiled, appended to the stable enum, and mapped to the matching embedded shader bytes.

Candidate-versus-baseline-versus-host coverage for f32/f16/bf16 at K=64, 896, and 4864; N=7, 9, and 37 covers short and partial final workgroups; bits=8 verifies the specialization guard falls back. The suite reaches whichever reduction path the device capability gate selects.

coverage_note: There is no explicit runtime case above K=4864. The source guard is present and correct; I did not propose or execute an unsafe over-limit fixture under the assignment constraints.
